title: Finite-coefficient evaluation of the quotient-diagram projection mate
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $I\subset A$ an ideal, $A_n=A/I^n$ for $n\ge1$, and $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal X)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal Y)$ a morphism of topoi presented by sites small in the module universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Write $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}(\underline A_T))$ for the ordinary unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], $u^*\dashv P=Ru_*$ for the canonical derived adjunction, with counit $\varepsilon$ and ordinary derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Put $J=\mathbf N_{\ge1}^{\mathrm{op}}$ and use the small diagram sites of [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization]. Their constant ring sheaves are $\Delta\underline A_T$ and their quotient ring sheaves are $B_T=(\underline{A_n}_T)_n$ with the actual quotient transitions. A $B_T$-module system consists of module sheaves $M_n$ over $\underline{A_n}_T$ and $\underline{A_{n+1}}_T$-linear transition maps to $M_n$ by restriction of scalars. Write $U_T$ for restriction to constant-$A$ towers, $S_T=-\otimes^L_{\Delta\underline A_T}B_T$, $\mathcal R_T=S_T\Delta$, and $i_V:\Delta V\to U_T\mathcal R_TV$ for the quotient augmentation. Write $G=u^*$ termwise, $P^J=Ru_*^J$ for derived termwise direct image on constant-$A$ towers, $G_B\dashv P_B$ for the quotient-ring diagram adjunction, and $\mathcal L_T=R\lim$ on constant-$A$ towers [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. All derived adjunctions are the ones induced from the module adjunctions, not separately chosen hom-set bijections. Use the canonical scalar-extension tensor comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For arbitrary $H\in D_{\mathcal X}$ and $K\in D_{\mathcal Y}$ put $M=PH\otimes_A^LK$ and $N=H\otimes_A^Lu^*K$. Let $h_H:\mathcal R_{\mathcal Y}PH\to P_B\mathcal R_{\mathcal X}H$ be the coefficient mate with transpose $S_{\mathcal X}\Delta(\varepsilon_H)$. Let $\pi_B$ be the counit-defined projection for $G_B\dashv P_B$. The scalar-extension identifications
$$\mathcal R_{\mathcal Y}M\cong\mathcal R_{\mathcal Y}PH\otimes_{B_{\mathcal Y}}^L\mathcal R_{\mathcal Y}K,\qquad\mathcal R_{\mathcal X}N\cong\mathcal R_{\mathcal X}H\otimes_{B_{\mathcal X}}^LG_B\mathcal R_{\mathcal Y}K$$
define the single quotient-diagram arrow $v=\pi_B(h_H\otimes1):\mathcal R_{\mathcal Y}M\to P_B\mathcal R_{\mathcal X}N$. Put $H_n=H\otimes_A^L\underline{A_n}$, $K_n=K\otimes_A^L\underline{A_n}$ and let $u_n^*\dashv Ru_{*,A_n}$ be the ordinary quotient-coefficient adjunction. Exact evaluation and the derived restriction/direct-image comparisons identify the evaluation of this arrow with
$$\operatorname{ev}_n(v)=\pi^{(n)}_{H_n,K_n}(h_{H,n}\otimes_{A_n}^L1_{K_n}),$$
where $h_{H,n}:(PH)_n\to Ru_{*,A_n}H_n$ is the evaluated coefficient mate and $\pi^{(n)}$ is the adjunct of the quotient counit tensored with identity. The source is balanced as $M_n\cong(PH)_n\otimes_{A_n}^LK_n$ and the target as $Ru_{*,A_n}(H_n\otimes_{A_n}^Lu_n^*K_n)$. The evaluation comparisons carry the diagram adjunction to this specified finite adjunction, including its counit. The identifications are natural and compatible with quotient transitions. No preservation of K-injectives by varying-ring evaluation, perfectness, completeness or flatness of the quotients is assumed.
